About

Hi! I'm Nolan, 15 years old.

I started Cloudy to Clear to earn, learn, and help my community drive safer. Cloudy headlights reduce your visibility at night and restoring them is something I am genuinely good at.

I take pride in every job and will not leave until you are happy with the result.
